Yeah. One Saturday evening. Remember this, you and Precian, Emma and myself. For sure. Because of piano, a drum, cornet and trombone. We did a television show. Played all them numbers. WDSU, a show, played them. Four-piece band. I hope you realize it's, it's, when you take any four people, the chances of them ever getting together is 1-16. Yeah.
